source.author: R. P. Bielat
source.note: The NTRS download carries a 436-byte wrapper before %PDF-1.6; the stripped copy (bytes 437 onward) is the file read.

figure.title: Variation with lift coefficient of the aerodynamic characteristics for the 35 deg sweptback wing. (a) Angle of attack.
figure.x_axis: Lift coefficient, CL (staggered: each Mach number has its own CL = 0, marked by a 0 label and a heavier vertical line)
figure.y_axis: Angle of attack, alpha, deg (common to all Mach numbers)
figure.content_note: Measured points: hollow symbols with a centre dot on one faired line per Mach number. Same test points as figure 6(b).

scan.extraction: tools/digitize/extract_scan.py: the page's single embedded image, rotated by the page /Rotate value (90) to read upright

calibration.x_definition: Common staggered axis: left frame -0.2, grid every 0.1; one 0 label every 0.2 from 0.0 (M 0.50) to 2.4 (M 1.13); then .2 .4 .6 of M 1.13 at 2.6 to 3.0 (right frame).

points.note: Sits on the alpha = -2 deg line (top border of the label box); not found by candidates.py.
p2 and p3: two circles on top of each other (repeated point), two dots.
p6 and p7: double circle (repeated point), two dots.
Three overlapping diamonds near alpha 7.3 (p5, p6, p11); no centre dots visible; outline centre of the lower-left one. First pass A read two diamonds here; corrected after pass B's report.
Lower-right diamond of the three; outline centre.

Upper diamond of two overlapping diamonds at alpha 0.3 (with p2); centre from the outline. Missed in the first pass A reading; added after pass B reported it and confirmed on the scan; this pick is not independent of pass B.

Upper diamond of the three (top vertex 1268,823; right vertex 1286,841); outline centre. Missed in the first pass A reading; added after pass B reported it and confirmed on the scan; this pick is not independent of pass B.
Three overlapping triangles near alpha 7.3 (p5, p6, p11), dots hidden; outline centroid of the left one (apex 1428,836; base y 857).
Upper-right triangle of the three (apex 1443,824; base y 846, x 1430-1457); outline centroid.

Lower dot of two triangles drawn on top of each other at alpha 0.3 (with p2); faint and touching the base line, placed by eye. Missed in the first pass A reading; added after pass B reported it and confirmed on the scan; this pick is not independent of pass B.

Lower-right triangle of the three (base y 853.5, x 1432-1457; apex hidden); outline centroid. Matches the three symbols of figure 6(b). Missed in the first pass A reading; added after pass B reported it and confirmed on the scan; this pick is not independent of pass B.
Crossed by the alpha = 0 line and probably doubled; no clear dot. Outline centroid (left side x 1332, y 1372-1398, apex 1360,1385); uncertainty about 2 px.

points.note: Lower of two quarter discs drawn one over the other at alpha about 0.2 (top edges at rows 1351 and 1361.5). Its dot touches the faired line; placed by eye.

assignment_method: Candidates grouped in alpha bands and ordered by common-axis CL: within each band the Mach numbers appear left to right in test order. Shapes checked against the symbol next to each Mach label.
